name: Stacking Upgrades
summary: A bag of upgrades that stack, recomputed from scratch every time, and never deduplicated.
description: The spine of a roguelite build. Upgrades are a list of ids with the duplicates left in, and every stat is recomputed from that list whenever it changes -- so two copies are exactly two applications, always, with no special case anywhere, and removing one is as exact as adding one. Effects are a data table rather than a switch, so adding an upgrade is one row that whatever draws your cards can also read. It deliberately does not know what a stat means: it adds numbers up and hands them over.
nextSteps: Put Upgrades.js on whatever owns the stats, usually the player, and tag it Upgrades.
Fill in UPGRADES: one row per upgrade, each with a list of {stat, op, value} effects.
Read them with stat("maxHp") and mul("damage") -- never cache the result, it changes.
Put anything that must be re-derived rather than read into onStatsChanged().
